```{r read_and_list_files}

#read in files
library(tidyverse)
homicides <- read_csv("../data/homicide-data.csv")

#list files
list.files("../data")

```
```{r clean data}

homicides <- homicides %>%
  #create new column by combining two existing: name it, call the columns 
  #to combine, specify the separator
  unite("city_state", city:state, sep = ", ") %>%
  #make date column date class
  #overwrite homicides dataframe, add new "seasons" column
  #make Winter= Nov-Apr, Summer= May-Oct
  mutate(date = ymd(reported_date),
         season = if_else(month(date) %in% c(11, 12, 1, 2, 3, 4),"Winter", "Summer"),
         year = year(date), 
         month = month(date)) %>%
  #filter for just Baltimore homicides
  filter(city_state == "Baltimore, MD") %>%
  #group by month to find counts
  group_by(year, month) %>%
  mutate(month_count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

homicides <- homicides %>%
  select(year, month, season, month_count)

month_homicides <- homicides %>%
  distinct(year, month, season, month_count)

```

``` {r plot}

#Recreate the graph shown below. It shows monthly homicides in Baltimore, with a reference added for the date of the arrest of Freddie Gray and color used to show colder months (November through April) versus warmer months (May through October). There is a smooth line added to help show seasonal and long-term trends in this data.

#to-do
#make smooth line more responsive
#should I use loess method for smooth line? can't tell until you fix below problem
#remove the extra layers of bars
#make sure we're only counting month by year, not every month count for every january (which is what you're doing now) this is why y-axis looks so bad, should only go to 40, these are duplicates
#make fig width larger to accommodate

library(forcats)
library(ggthemes)
library(scales)
library(ggplot2)

month_homicides %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = homicides$date, y = month_count)) +
  geom_col(aes(x = homicides$date, y = month_count, fill = month_homicides$season)) +
  # geom_smooth(span = 0.3) +
  #red line for Freddie Gray arrest + annotation
  geom_vline(xintercept = ymd("2015-04-12"), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = ymd("2015-03-01"), y = 40, 
           label = "Arrest of\nFreddie Gray", color = "gray90", hjust = 1, size = 3.8, lineheight = 0.95) +
  #labels
  labs(title = "Homicides in Baltimore, MD", 
       y = "Monthly homicides",
       x = "Date") +
  theme_dark() +
  #put legend in bottom position
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  #custom fill colors and x-axis 2-year breaks
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Summer" = "lightgray", "Winter" = "lightblue")) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y")

```
